go on a picnic: We are going on a picnic in the park this Sunday.
我们打算这个星期天去公园野餐。
pick apples: In autumn, we often pick apples on my uncle's farm.
秋天,我们经常在叔叔的农场里摘苹果。
snowman: The children made a big snowman in front of the house.
孩子们在房子前面堆了一个大雪人。
make a snowman: Let's make a snowman when it stops snowing.
等雪停了,我们来堆个雪人吧。
I usually go swimming with my friends in summer.
夏天我通常和朋友们去游泳。
good job: You cleaned the classroom all by yourself. Good job!
你自己把教室打扫得干干净净,做得好!
March: My birthday is in March, just before spring begins.
我的生日在三月,就在春天开始之前。
May: The flowers usually open in May when the weather gets warm.
五月天气转暖时,花通常就开了。
a few: There are a few books about science on the shelf.
书架上有几本关于科学的书。
sports meet: Our school will hold a sports meet next Friday.
我们学校下周五将举行运动会。
the Great Wall: Many visitors from different countries come to see the Great Wall every year.
每年都有许多来自不同国家的游客来参观长城。
National Day: We have a seven-day holiday for National Day in October.
十月国庆节我们有七天假期。
American: She is learning American history at school this term.
她这学期在学校学习美国历史。
Thanksgiving: Families get together and enjoy a big meal on Thanksgiving.
感恩节那天,家人团聚,享用丰盛的大餐。
look for: I can't find my keys, so I'm looking for them everywhere.
我找不到钥匙了,正在到处寻找。
bunny: The little girl keeps a white bunny as her pet.
小女孩养了一只白色的兔子当宠物。
RSVP: Please RSVP by Friday so we know how many people are coming.
请在星期五之前回复,以便我们知道有多少人会来。
twenty-first: Her office is on the twenty-first floor of the building.
她的办公室在这栋楼的第二十一层。
twenty-third: Today is the twenty-third of December, and it is very cold.
今天是十二月二十三日,天气非常冷。
thirtieth: This is the thirtieth page of my diary.
这是我日记的第三十页。
climbing: The boys are climbing the hill behind their village.
男孩们正在爬村子后面的那座小山。
eating: The pandas are eating bamboo in the zoo.
熊猫们正在动物园里吃竹子。
playing: The kids are playing football on the playground after class.
下课后孩子们正在操场上踢足球。
jumping: Look! The rabbit is jumping over the grass.
看!那只兔子正跳过草地。
drinking: He is drinking a glass of milk in the kitchen.
他正在厨房里喝一杯牛奶。
sleeping: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping in the next room.
安静点!宝宝正在隔壁房间睡觉。
each other: The two friends often help each other with their homework.
这两个朋友经常在作业上互相帮助。
excited: She was so excited about the trip that she couldn't sleep.
她对这次旅行非常兴奋,激动得睡不着觉。
doing morning exercises: Many old people are doing morning exercises in the park.
许多老人正在公园里做早操。
having...class: The students are having an English class in the bright classroom.
学生们正在明亮的教室里上英语课。
eating lunch: We are eating lunch together in the school dining hall.
我们正在学校食堂一起吃午饭。
reading a book: My father likes reading a book before going to bed.
我爸爸喜欢在睡前看书。
listening to music: She is listening to music while doing her homework.
她一边听音乐一边做作业。
keep to the right: In China, we should keep to the right when walking upstairs.
在中国,上楼时我们应该靠右走。
keep your desk clean: Please keep your desk clean and tidy every day.
请每天保持课桌干净整洁。
talk quietly: You should talk quietly in the library.
在图书馆里你应该小声讲话。
take turns: The students take turns to clean the blackboard.
have a look: Come and have a look at my new bike.
来看看我的新自行车吧。
sushi: I tried sushi for the first time and liked it very much.
我第一次吃寿司,非常喜欢它。
Canadian: My new friend is a Canadian, and he speaks English and French.
我的新朋友是加拿大人,他会说英语和法语。
